source: Mortgage News Daily; CME FedWatch via Real Estate News

headline: Stock selloff
*pulls rates down*
slides.sub: Down from 7.45% a day earlier, the lowest level since Nov. 10.

slides.title: Rates by *loan type*
slides.note: Every product fell on the day. The 7/6 ARM dropped the most, *down 0.19 points*, while the 30-year fell 0.12.

slides.title: A season of *whiplash*
points: Nov. 20: *7.33%*, as a Nasdaq drop of more than 5% sent investors into bonds.

slides.label: odds of a *Fed rate hike* in December
slides.body: That is Friday's CME FedWatch reading for a quarter-point increase at the Dec. 8-9 meeting, down from 94% on Thursday. The 10-year Treasury yield slipped below 5% in the selloff.

slides.title: Watch the *daily swings*
slides.body: Rates are moving a tenth of a point or more in a day, and the Fed meets Dec. 8-9. Keep active buyers in close touch with their lenders so quotes and lock timing stay current.
